name: Residual Boundary Algebra completion space — refined after assertion-collapse tests
preserved_scope: standard 7x6 ordinary exact strong state/action value and best move

newly_fixed_or_excluded.statement: For a fixed legal one-cell coordinate cofactor, adjoining immediate terminal WIN_NOW as a top element yields a total finite join-preserving map on the tested residual upset lattices.
The tested terminal-extended cofactor F satisfies a full Galois adjunction with the exact right adjoint R: F(x)<=y iff x<=R(y).
Cofactor is not generally meet-preserving; residual contraction can create new comparabilities.
Fixed legal action-word coordinate propagation composes exactly and maps each principal residual to principal residual, killed/bottom, or terminal.
The right adjoints of tested fixed-step maps compose in reverse order.
The Galois pair induces parent closure C=R∘F and child interior I=F∘R; closure-fixed count, interior-fixed count, and distinct forward-image count coincide on every tested action.
Along every tested fixed future word, the induced parent closures become monotonically more extensive and their fixed-point/image distinctions never increase.
The entire immediate single-player true+false action interface is injective on both pathological supports, so path-local contraction must not be promoted to an unconditional global carrier quotient.
Two-ply alternating max/min strong-value composition with exact terminal timing reproduces one-ply recurrence exactly on the complete two pathological abstract q domains.
A finite rank-free nested max/min expression exists in the weak sense because the standard game graph is finite and acyclic; the remaining question is compact representation, not existence.

What structural parameter bounds the size of exact threshold/boundary representations and composed transformers toward the empty root?

Given that fixed transition words and alternating quantifiers compose exactly, can their value-threshold/boundary transformers be composed and normalized compactly enough to avoid explicit rank-by-rank boundary construction?
Does the finite exact full-depth expression admit a compact direct-root normal form rather than exponential syntactic expansion?
Can exact ordinary value use a strictly coarser carrier than the current residual/q lattice while retaining a compact forward-updatable algebra?
What exact relation connects the ordinary-value RBA to the clause/proof/controllable-predecessor region and C4-R0043/C4-R0069/C4-R0076?
Which refined RBA laws generalize beyond fixed standard 7x6 and with what complexity?
Are the current adjoint/threshold/blocker factorizations canonical, or are there smaller equivalent presentations?

How do the path-local Galois closures interact under the full set of competing legal actions so that an almost-injective transition interface collapses to only hundreds of action-score vectors and tens of state-value/policy classes?
